A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same OBI-Bench work with complete main text, Appendices A-E, 13 tables, and 18 figures. The text, equations, numerical results, and image-based appendix material support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations across five OBI tasks in Tables 2-6, human-study results, and supplementary experiments and analyses in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original model and human evaluation results, including the main benchmark scores and supplementary results in Tables 10-12.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction and LMM querying procedures remain unchanged, including the four question types and appendix role-assignment and case-instruction prompts. No model component or inference procedure is revised.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 5,523-image benchmark, 11 source datasets, and five tasks. Appendix coverage also remains unchanged, including mixed OBI/non-OBI recognition tests and five undeciphered-character case studies.

E2.justification: The same six proprietary and 17 open-source LMMs participate, with unchanged experiment-specific subsets in Tables 2-6, 10, and 12. Human comparison results are also retained.

E3.justification: The main zero-shot settings, dataset sampling, reference/query splits, metrics, model configurations, and human-study procedures are unchanged. The appendix prompting experiments retain their existing protocols.

E4.justification: Both retain class-count sensitivity analysis (Figure 3), judgment-bias and image-quality tests (Tables 10-11), prompting comparisons (Table 12), cultural-origin analysis (Figure 13), and unknown-character case studies (Figures 14-18).

E5.justification: Appendix C.1 reports the same five-round averaging strategy in both versions. No seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty-reporting procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results in the main text and appendices and the qualitative figure outputs are unchanged. For example, GPT-4o's rejoining Acc@10 remains 78.47% in Table 3, and its average deciphering score remains 0.3876 in Table 6.

T1.justification: The evaluation mathematics, including the MRE definition in Appendix C.2.1, Equation (1), remains unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark contribution and conclusions about weak fine-grained perception and promising deciphering assistance. Correcting 'LLMs' to 'LMMs' in the introduction does not change the intended claim.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning image quality, model scale, visual associations in deciphering, and prompting effects remain unchanged. Appendix D retains the same limitations concerning coverage, simple queries, missing context, and subjective reference descriptions.

D1.justification: Data collection and annotation procedures, implementation settings, embedding-model details, prompt templates, and code/data access statements are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment supplies no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: v2 adds Chen et al.'s Band-2k paper to the consent-procedure citation in Appendix A.2 and the bibliography. The previously cited GAIA and naturalness-assessment papers remain under shifted year-letter labels; the broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited grammar and terminology corrections throughout the main text and appendices, replaces the preprint header with an ICLR 2025 publication header, and adds funding acknowledgments before the references. The existing narrative and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: v2 slightly shifts the abstract and Figure 1 upward and reflows text and references around the editorial additions. The 18 figures and 13 tables retain their contents and designs; none are added, removed, or redrawn.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves readability through grammar and terminology corrections and adds explicit funding attribution. The benchmark, experimental evidence, analyses, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to editorial clarity and disclosure.
